definitions.gloss: to take medicine; to administer orally
definitions.explanation: To take medicine by mouth. A formal word used in medical and pharmaceutical contexts for oral medication.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{服用|ふくよう}する。
⟦{食後|しょくご}→食後：09499_shokugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一錠|いちじょう}{服用|ふくよう}して⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take one tablet after meals.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長期|ちょうき}→長期：03487_chouki⟧{服用|ふくよう}する⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Long-term use of this medicine can cause side effects.

notes:
A formal, medical term for taking medication orally. Found on medicine packaging, in doctor's instructions, and in pharmaceutical literature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{服用|ふくよう}{量|りょう}→服用量：25128_fukuyouryou⟧: dosage
- ⟦{服用|ふくよう}→服用：15267_fukuyou⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: how to take (the medicine)
- ⟦{服用|ふくよう}→服用：15267_fukuyou⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: period of administration
- ⟦{長期|ちょうき}→長期：03487_chouki⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}→服用：15267_fukuyou⟧: long-term use
- ⟦{食前|しょくぜん}→食前：20726_shokuzen⟧/⟦{食後|しょくご}→食後：09499_shokugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}→服用：15267_fukuyou⟧: take before/after meals

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink/take (medicine) — everyday, conversational
- ⟦{投与|とうよ}→投与：12894_touyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to administer (medicine) — from the doctor/nurse's perspective
- ⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to ingest — broader, includes food and nutrients

REGISTER:
More formal than ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧. In daily conversation, people say ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ rather than {服用|ふくよう}する. ⟦{服用|ふくよう}→服用：15267_fukuyou⟧ appears on prescription labels, medicine inserts, and in medical instructions.
